entries.signature: pub(super) fn validate_staging_layout( path: &Path, output_dir: &Path, operation_id: &str, require_operation: bool, ) -> Result<(PathBuf, PathBuf, String), String>
callers: reset_staging_dir and existing staging validation callers.
inputs: Expected operation staging path, canonicalizable output directory, operation UUID and require_operation flag.
sideEffects: Attempts create_dir only when creation is allowed; AlreadyExists proceeds to validation rather than failing legitimate concurrent creation.
errors: The unpatched test reproduced Windows error 183; all other I/O and unsafe-layout errors remain failures.
ownership: Existing staging root and per-operation lease ownership are preserved.
locks: No new lock; atomic create_dir plus subsequent regular-directory and canonical-parent validation handles the race.
invariants: An existing file, reparse directory or escaped canonical root is still rejected; requiring an existing operation never creates its root.
tests: cargo test --lib --features local-preview: 396 passed, 4 ignored, including the new simultaneous staging regression and existing path/marker tests.
evidence: Red/green concurrent startup regression and complete 396-test Rust suite; existing path and marker tests retain containment checks.
entries.purpose: Initialize the shared staging root idempotently under concurrent download startup, then enforce the existing directory identity and containment checks.
entries.output: Validated canonical root, operation path and normalized ID, or an explicit validation error.
entries.cancellation: No asynchronous work is introduced; scoped test threads are joined and existing staging cleanup ownership remains unchanged.
entries.reviewer: Codex native QC follow-up source review
entries.notes: Extracted the reviewed staging layout validation into a cohesive private child module. It imports only the parent path builder and metadata classifier; creation, validation and errors are unchanged. The staging file ceiling is lowered, not raised.
